declaredOptions.label: Allow network access
declaredOptions.description: Lets the story load http and https resources; off keeps it entirely offline (TwinePlugin.java:43).

declaredOptions.label: JavaScript
declaredOptions.description: Every compiled Twine story needs this; turning it off is for inspecting a story that misbehaves (TwinePlugin.java:47).

declaredOptions.label: DOM storage
declaredOptions.description: Enables localStorage, which Twine's save system is built on (TwinePlugin.java:48).

declaredOptions.label: Web SQL database
declaredOptions.description: Enables the WebView database some older story formats use (TwinePlugin.java:49).

declaredOptions.label: Require a tap before audio
declaredOptions.description: When on, audio and video only start after the reader touches the screen (TwinePlugin.java:54).
